sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 显然，她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候觉得需要支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您使用的应用程序上的本期节目shownotes（节目文稿），或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: In 1920, the country of Ireland consisted of two self-governing territories,
sentences.zh: 1920年，爱尔兰由两个自治领地组成，

sentences.en: Northern Ireland and Southern Ireland, both of which belonged to the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 即北爱尔兰和南爱尔兰，两者都属于英国。

sentences.en: Following the War of Independence and the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 1921,
sentences.zh: 在独立战争和1921年《英爱条约》之后，

sentences.en: Southern Ireland declared independence from the UK and became the Republic of Ireland, while Northern Ireland remained under British rule.
sentences.zh: 南爱尔兰宣布脱离英国独立并成为爱尔兰共和国，而北爱尔兰则继续由英国统治。

sentences.en: This partitioning caused great conflict between the two regions, with Irish nationalists in the Republic wanting all of Ireland to be reunified as an independent country,
sentences.zh: 这种划分导致了两个地区之间的巨大冲突，共和国境内的爱尔兰民族主义者希望整个爱尔兰重新统一为一个独立国家，

sentences.en: while Unionists in the North didn't agree.
sentences.zh: 而北方的统一派则不同意。

sentences.en: Many inhabitants of Northern Ireland were descended from English ancestors and identified more as British instead of Irish, hence their loyalty to the UK.
sentences.zh: 北爱尔兰的许多居民是英国祖先的后代，他们认同自己是英国人而非爱尔兰人，因此对英国忠心耿耿。

sentences.en: The fact that the Unionists were mainly of Protestant background, while the Nationalists were predominantly Catholic, only furthered the divide.
sentences.zh: 统一派主要具有新教背景，而民族主义者主要为天主教徒，这一事实进一步加深了裂痕。

sentences.en: In 1968, a period known as the Troubles began, marking a battle for control between those who thought Northern Ireland should be returned to the Republic
sentences.zh: 1968年，被称为“动荡时期”（The Troubles）的时期开始了，这标志着认为北爱尔兰应当回归共和国的人们

sentences.en: and to those who felt it should remain under British rule.
sentences.zh: 与认为北爱尔兰应继续受英国统治的人们之间争夺控制权的斗争。

sentences.en: Leading the charge was the Irish Republican Army, or IRA, also known as the Provisional Irish Republican Army.
sentences.zh: 冲在最前面的是爱尔兰共和军，简称“爱尔兰共和军”（IRA），也被称为临时爱尔兰共和军。

sentences.en: The IRA was an illegal paramilitary organisation whose primary goal was to force the United Kingdom to negotiate a withdrawal from Northern Ireland.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰共和军是一个非法的准军事组织，其主要目标是迫使英国谈判从北爱尔兰撤军。

sentences.en: They sought to bring about unification of Ireland through any means, including violence and terrorism.
sentences.zh: 他们试图通过任何手段（包括暴力和恐怖主义）来实现爱尔兰的统一。

sentences.en: When the Troubles began, fighting between the IRA and British soldiers from Northern Ireland was at an all-time high.
sentences.zh: 当“动荡时期”开始时，爱尔兰共和军与来自北爱尔兰的英国士兵之间的战斗达到了空前的高潮。

sentences.en: Over the years, the IRA bombed political and economic targets across Northern Ireland and England, using guerrilla tactics in both urban and rural areas.
sentences.zh: 多年来，爱尔兰共和军在北爱尔兰和英格兰各地轰炸了政治和经济目标，在城市和乡村地区都使用了游击战术。

sentences.en: Years of extreme protesting and violence had culminated in low morale and widespread despair throughout Ireland and the economy was in trouble,
sentences.zh: 多年的极端抗议和暴力活动最终导致爱尔兰全国上下士气低落、普遍绝望，经济也陷入困境，

sentences.en: resulting in high unemployment rates and mass emigration.
sentences.zh: 导致高失业率和大规模移民。

sentences.en: Yet, one industry that continued to thrive was horse racing, which provided 20,000 jobs and attracted large sums of money from overseas.
sentences.zh: 然而，赛马这一行业却继续蓬勃发展，它提供了两万个就业岗位，并吸引了大量来自海外的资金。

sentences.en: In 1980, an Irish racehorse named Shurgar took the industry by storm, becoming a racing champion and national treasure.
sentences.zh: 1980年，一匹名叫谢加（Shurgar）的爱尔兰赛马席卷了整个赛马界，成为了赛马冠军和民族瑰宝。

sentences.en: The Irish public adored Shurgar, and watching him achieve great success provided a much-needed distraction from the Troubles.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰公众非常喜爱谢加，看他取得巨大成功为人们提供了一个急需的、从“动荡时期”抽离的机会。

sentences.en: He became a symbol of hope and possibility in an otherwise bleak and trying time.
sentences.zh: 在那个原本阴暗艰难的时期，他成为了希望和可能性的象征。

sentences.en: Shurgar was born on March 3, 1978, at Cheshun, a private stud farm in the Irish county of Kildare.
sentences.zh: 谢加于1978年3月3日出生于爱尔兰基尔代尔郡的切舒恩（Cheshun）私人种马场。

sentences.en: His father was a British-born thoroughbred racehorse named Great Nephew, and his mother was Charmeen,
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一匹出生于英国纯种赛马名叫伟大侄子（Great Nephew），母亲是沙尔敏（Charmeen），

sentences.en: a thoroughbred who had produced many other successful racehorses throughout her breeding career.
sentences.zh: 她是一匹纯种母马，在其繁育生涯中产下了许多其他成功的赛马。

sentences.en: Shurgar was a quintessential thoroughbred.
sentences.zh: 谢加是一匹典型的纯种马。

sentences.en: He was tall and lean, with an athletic build ideal for racing.
sentences.zh: 他身材高大而修长，拥有非常适合赛马的运动体格。

sentences.en: He had a light brown coat with a black mane and tail, and four white socks on his legs.
sentences.zh: 他有着浅棕色的皮毛，黑色的鬃毛和尾巴，四条腿上长着四个白色的蹄部标记。

sentences.en: Running down his nose was a wide white stripe, known as a blaze, and one of his eyes was blue, a phenomenon called a walleye.
sentences.zh: 顺着他的鼻梁有一道宽宽的白条，被称为流星斑，他的其中一只眼睛是蓝色的，这种现象被称为壁眼（白眼）。

sentences.en: Some horse racing professionals believed that horses with a walleye are predisposed to being skittish and temperamental, but trainers who worked with Shurgar dismissed this theory,
sentences.zh: 一些赛马专业人士认为，有壁眼的马容易胆小且喜怒无常，但与谢加合作的驯马师驳斥了这一理论，

sentences.en: finding him laid back and easy to train.
sentences.zh: 他们发现他性格悠闲且很容易训练。

sentences.en: The Shishun stud farm was owned by Prince Karim, a Muslim leader better known in the West as His Highness Aga Khan IV.
sentences.zh: 希舒恩（Shishun）种马场由卡里姆王子拥有，他是一位穆斯林领袖，在西方更广为人知的名字是阿迦汗四世殿下（His Highness Aga Khan IV）。

sentences.en: As the 49th spiritual leader of the Shia Ismaili Muslims, the Aga Khan is believed to be a direct descendant of the Prophet Muhammad.
sentences.zh: 作为什叶派伊斯玛仪派穆斯林的第49代精神领袖，人们认为阿迦汗是先知穆罕默德的直系后裔。

sentences.en: Shia Islam has an estimated 15 million followers, and the Aga Khan is considered to be their king and spiritual guide.
sentences.zh: 什叶派伊斯兰教估计拥有1500万信徒，阿迦汗被认为是他们的国王和精神向导。

sentences.en: In 1957, he inherited his position from his grandfather, Aga Khan III, at the age of 20, and grew up to be a business magnate, humanitarian worker, and racehorse breeder.
sentences.zh: 1957年，他在20岁时从祖父阿迦汗三世那里继承了这一职位，后来成长为一名商业大亨、人道主义工作者和赛马繁育者。

sentences.en: During his time as leader, the Aga Khan has been celebrated for his exceptional contributions to human development, and has received numerous awards and honorary degrees
sentences.zh: 在他担任领袖期间，阿迦汗因对人类发展做出杰出贡献而受到赞誉，并获得了无数奖项和荣誉学位，

sentences.en: from institutions throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 这些荣誉来自全球各地的机构。

sentences.en: He is also a billionaire, who has been described by Forbes magazine as one of the world's 10 richest royals.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位亿万富翁，被《福布斯》杂志形容为世界上最富有的10位皇室成员之一。

sentences.en: Over the years, the Aga Khan has amassed assets such as valuable stud farms, hundreds of award-winning racehorses, an exclusive Italian yacht club,
sentences.zh: 多年来，阿迦汗积累了大量资产，例如价值不菲的种马场、数百匹屡获殊荣的赛马、一家专属的意大利游艇俱乐部、

sentences.en: a private island in the Bahamas, several estates, and two jets.
sentences.zh: 巴哈马的一座私人岛屿、数处庄园以及两架喷气式飞机。

sentences.en: Shurgar was trained to be a racehorse from a young age and grew up to become one of the Aga Khan's
sentences.zh: 谢加从小就被训练成为一匹赛马，长大后成为了阿迦汗最伟大的成功故事之一，

sentences.en: greatest success stories, known for his nice temperament and for having a certain elegance in the way he moved.
sentences.zh: 他以温顺的性格和某种优雅的步伐而闻名。

sentences.en: He was more relaxed and affectionate than the average thoroughbred, which appealed to his owners and the public, who nicknamed him Island's Pegasus.
sentences.zh: 他比一般的纯种马更加放松和亲人，这吸引了他的主人和公众，他们给她起了个绰号叫“岛屿飞马”。

sentences.en: One of Shurgar's most endearing features was that when he galloped at full pace, his tongue lulled out the side of his mouth, which one racing commentator said
sentences.zh: 谢加最迷人的特征之一是，当他全速奔驰时，他的舌头会耷拉在嘴巴的一侧，正如一位赛马解说员所说，

sentences.en: made him look like a 10-year-old solving a tricky maths problem.
sentences.zh: 这让他看起来像个正在解数学难题的10岁小孩。

sentences.en: Shurgar's trainer was Michael Stout, a Barbados native hired by the Aga Khan in 1978.
sentences.zh: 谢加的驯马师是迈克尔·斯托特（Michael Stout），他是阿迦汗于1978年雇用的巴巴多斯本地人。

sentences.en: Regarded as an up-and-comer, Michael had worked as an assistant to famous British horse trainer Pat Rowan and already had some big wins under his belt.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔被视为后起之秀，曾担任英国著名赛马驯马师帕特·罗文（Pat Rowan）的助手，并且已经取得了一些重大胜利。

sentences.en: He began training Shurgar at the Beechhurst stables in the English town of Newmarket, but initially saw nothing special about him, viewing him as somewhat immature.
sentences.zh: 他开始在英国纽马克特的比奇赫斯特马厩训练谢加，但起初并没有看出他有什么特别之处，认为他多少有些不成熟。

sentences.en: In August 1980, jockey Lester Piggott began taking Shurgar out for morning rides, and the two quickly formed a bond.
sentences.zh: 1980年8月，骑师莱斯特·皮哥特（Lestor Piggott）开始带谢加进行晨练，两人很快建立起了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: Lester was one of only two jockeys who ever rode Shurgar, the other being Walter Swinburne.
sentences.zh: 莱斯特是骑过谢加仅有的两位骑师之一，另一位是沃尔特·斯温伯恩（Walter Swinburne）。

sentences.en: When racing Shurgar, the two jockeys dressed in the racing colours of the Aga Khan, an emerald green cap and jacket with red epaulets.
sentences.zh: 在骑谢加比赛时，这两位骑师穿着阿迦汗的赛马服，即带有红色肩章的翡翠绿帽子和夹克。

sentences.en: Shurgar's racing career began at the Crease Plate in Newbury on September 19, 1980, when he was two and a half years old.
sentences.zh: 谢加的赛马生涯始于1980年9月19日在纽伯里举行的克里兹杯（Crease Plate），当时他两岁半。

sentences.en: He was the favourite to win at odds of 11 to 8, and after initially keeping behind, he ultimately won by two and a half lengths.
sentences.zh: 他是以11赔8的赔率夺冠的热门人选，在起初落后之后，最终以两个半马身的优势获胜。

sentences.en: This style of racing became his signature, with Shurgar often sitting in third or fourth place until he sped up and ultimately overtook the winning horses in the final straight.
sentences.zh: 这种比赛风格成为了他的标志，谢加通常保持在第三或第四位，直到加速并在最后的直道上超越了获胜的马匹。

sentences.en: Between 1980 and 1981, he went on to win six of the eight major races he competed in, including the Guardian newspaper Classic Trial,
sentences.zh: 在1980年至1981年间，他赢得了他参加的八场主要比赛中的六场，其中包括《卫报》经典预赛（Guardian newspaper Classic Trial）、

sentences.en: Chester Vars, the Epsom Derby, the Irish Derby, and the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Stakes.
sentences.zh: 切斯特瓦斯赛（Chester Vars）、叶森德比（Epsom Derby）、爱尔兰德比（Irish Derby）以及乔治六世国王和伊丽莎白女王锦标赛。

sentences.en: These collective wins were considered to be tremendous achievements in the racing world, and as Shurgar's reputation and prestige grew, so did his popularity.
sentences.zh: 这些集体胜利被认为是赛马界的巨大成就，随着谢加的声誉和名望不断增长，他的受欢迎程度也随之增加。

sentences.en: Horse racing enthusiast Richard Baerlein described his appeal in the Guardian newspaper, writing,
sentences.zh: 赛马爱好者理查德·贝尔林（Richard Baerlein）在《卫报》上描述了他的魅力，并写道：

sentences.en: To say Shurgar typifies the perfect racehorse would not be overstating the case.
sentences.zh: 要说谢加是完美赛马的典型代表，一点也不夸张。

sentences.en: His powers of acceleration are exceptional.
sentences.zh: 他的爆发力非常惊人。

sentences.en: One or two experts have told me they consider Shurgar the best horse they've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 有一两位专家告诉我，他们认为谢加是他们见过的最好的马。

sentences.en: In 1981, Shurgar was named European Horse of the Year, and he soon became a household name in Ireland and England, even amongst those who didn't follow racing.
sentences.zh: 1981年，谢加被评为欧洲年度马王，并很快在爱尔兰和英格兰家喻户晓，即使在那些不关注赛马的人中间也是如此。

sentences.en: On July 9 1981,
the Aga Khan announced he would be keeping Shurgar in Ireland in order to use him as a stud.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗宣布他将把谢加留在爱尔兰，以便将其用作种公马。

sentences.en: Unlike race winnings, which can be inconsistent and unpredictable, putting a racehorse to stud provides a steady income,
sentences.zh: 与可能不稳定且不可预测的比赛奖金不同，让赛马去配种能提供稳定的收入，

sentences.en: and the Aga Khan expected to breed ten of his mares to Shurgar each breeding season.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗预计在每个配种季让他的十匹母马与谢加交配。

sentences.en: The Aga Khan wanted to syndicate Shurgar, which meant selling shares so that ownership of the horse would be split between several individuals.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗想要对谢加进行财团联合所有，这意味着出售股份，以便将这匹马的所有权分散在几个人之间。

sentences.en: With 40 shares up for grabs, the Aga Khan revealed he would be keeping six shares and selling the remaining 34 at the price of 250,000 pounds each,
sentences.zh: 当时有40份股份可供争夺，阿迦汗透露他将保留6份，并以每份25万英镑的价格出售其余的34份，

sentences.en: the equivalent of around 1.5 million Australian dollars in today's money.
sentences.zh: 相当于今天价值约150万澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: Anyone who knew anything about horse racing wanted in on the action, and the shares were quickly snapped up.
sentences.zh: 任何懂赛马的人都想插一手，股份很快就被抢购一空。

sentences.en: In total, the syndicate invested 10 million pounds in Shurgar, which was a record at the time for a stallion at stud.
sentences.zh: 总共，财团向谢加投资了1000万英镑，这在当时创下了种公马的纪录。

sentences.en: It was reported that the Aga Khan could have made more money by shipping Shurgar to the United States,
sentences.zh: 据报道，如果阿迦汗把谢加运往美国，本可以赚更多的钱，

sentences.en: where some breeding syndicates were prepared to pay up to 40 million US dollars.
sentences.zh: 那里的一些育种财团准备支付高达4000万美元。

sentences.en: However, there had been a recent outbreak of a highly infectious equine venereal disease, known as contagious equine metritus, resulting in international travel restrictions.
sentences.zh: 然而，最近爆发了一种高度传染性的马匹性病，被称为传染性子宫炎，导致了国际旅行限制。

sentences.en: In addition, the Aga Khan wanted Shurgar to remain in Ireland because he was so well-loved by the public
sentences.zh: 此外，阿迦汗希望谢加留在爱尔兰，因为公众非常喜爱他，

sentences.en: and provided a respite for the tension between the Republic and Northern Ireland.
sentences.zh: 并且他缓和了共和国与北爱尔兰之间的紧张关系。

sentences.en: Owning shares in Shurgar was considered to be a great privilege and it was up to each shareholder to organise their own insurance.
sentences.zh: 拥有谢加的股份被认为是一项巨大的特权，每个股东都得自己负责安排保险。

sentences.en: Each of their individual policies ensured Shurgar for death caused by accident, illness, and disease.
sentences.zh: 他们各自的保单都确保谢加因意外、疾病和生病导致的死亡能获得理赔。

sentences.en: But only some of the policies covered theft.
sentences.zh: 但只有部分保单涵盖了盗窃。

sentences.en: Trainer Michael Stout and the Aga Khan wanted to race Shurgar in the October 1981 French Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, also known simply as the Arc.
sentences.zh: 驯马师迈克尔·斯托特和阿迦汗希望让谢加参加1981年10月的法国凯旋门大赛，该赛事也简称为凯旋门大赛。

sentences.en: To gain entry, Shurgar first needed to succeed in a prep race, so it was decided he would compete in the St. Leger Stakes at Doncaster in England.
sentences.zh: 为了获得参赛资格，谢加首先需要在热身赛中取得好成绩，因此决定让他参加英国唐卡斯特的圣烈治锦标赛。

sentences.en: It was the final race for the season and the last time Shurgar would race as a three-year-old.
sentences.zh: 这是该赛季的最后一场比赛，也是谢加作为三岁马的最后一场比赛。

sentences.en: Although he was a favourite, he finished in fourth place, with his poor performance attributed to the fact that it had rained heavily the previous evening.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是夺冠热门，但他最终名列第四，其糟糕的表现被归咎于前一天晚上下过大雨。

sentences.en: This loss meant that racing in the Arc was out of the picture.
sentences.zh: 这场失利意味着参加凯旋门大赛化为泡影。

sentences.en: The Aga Khan didn't want any further losses impacting on Shurgar's desirability as a stud,
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗不希望任何进一步的失利影响谢加作为种公马的吸引力，

sentences.en: and it was therefore decided that he be retired at the peak of his short yet illustrious racing career.
sentences.zh: 因此决定在他短暂而辉煌的赛马生涯巅峰时期让他退役。

sentences.en: To celebrate Shurgar's achievements, a public celebration was held in the Irish town of Newbridge,
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝谢加的成就，爱尔兰小镇纽布里奇举行了一场公众庆祝活动，

sentences.en: with the Aga Khan parading Shurgar in front of crowds along the main street while a pipe band played.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗带着谢加在主街的人群前巡游，同时有管乐队在演奏。

sentences.en: At the time of Shurgar's retirement, he was the most valuable stud horse in Ireland, making the Aga Khan the leading breeder.
sentences.zh: 在谢加退役时，他是爱尔兰最有价值的种公马，这使阿迦汗成为顶尖的育种者。

sentences.en: It was expected that Shurgar would produce many offspring who would be equally successful racehorses.
sentences.zh: 人们期望谢加能繁育出许多同样成功的赛马后代。

sentences.en: He was taken to the Ballymanni stud farm in Newbridge, where he was kept in a four-stalled stallion barn.
sentences.zh: 他被带到纽布里奇的巴利曼尼种马场，被安置在一个有四个马厩的种公马马厩里。

sentences.en: Like most other horse studs in Ireland at the time,
sentences.zh: 就像当时爱尔兰大多数其他马场一样，

sentences.en: Ballymanni had very few security measures in place.
sentences.zh: 巴利曼尼几乎没有采取什么安保措施。

sentences.en: The entrance consisted of a five-bar wooden gate that could be unlocked from the outside and led to the stables, where nameplates identified each of the horses.
sentences.zh: 入口处是一个可以从外面打开的五栏木门，通往马厩，马厩里有标明每匹马名字的铭牌。

sentences.en: The staff noted Shurgar was a very agreeable horse with a good temperament.
sentences.zh: 工作人员指出谢加是一匹非常温顺、脾气很好的马。

sentences.en: He was mainly looked after by 53-year-old horse groom Jim Fitzgerald, who lived with his wife and children down a quiet, tree-lined street a short walk from Ballymanni.
sentences.zh: 他主要由53岁的马夫吉姆·菲茨杰拉德照顾，吉姆和他的妻子及孩子住在离巴利曼尼不远、绿树成荫的安静街道上。

sentences.en: Jim's proximity to the stud farm was intentional, as his role required him to be available to attend to the horses at any and all times.
sentences.zh: 吉姆离种马场这么近是刻意安排的，因为他的职责要求他随时随地都能照看马匹。

sentences.en: He had a lifelong love of horses and had started working for the Aga Khan as an assistant when he was just 16.
sentences.zh: 他对马有着一生的热爱，在16岁时就开始为阿迦汗做助理。

sentences.en: Jim took his job very seriously and spent each day talking to the horses, immaculately cleaning their stables and grooming them thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 吉姆非常认真对待他的工作，每天都跟马说话，一丝不苟地清洁马厩并彻底为它们刷洗梳理。

sentences.en: When the 1982 breeding season arrived,
sentences.zh: 当1982年繁殖季到来时，

sentences.en: Shurgar was studded out at the cost of £70,000 per day, the equivalent of around $118,000 Australian dollars in today's money.
sentences.zh: 谢加的配种费用为每天7万英镑，相当于今天约11.8万澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: By the end of the year, he had fathered 37 foals and was booked to breed with 55 mares in the 1983 season, which was due to commence on February 14.
sentences.zh: 到年底，他已经繁育了37匹马驹，并预定在将于2月14日开始的1983年繁殖季与55匹母马交配。

sentences.en: One week prior, on Tuesday February 8, a large horse auction hosted by Goff's sales took place in the village of Kill, located 22 kilometres south-west of Ballymanni.
sentences.zh: 一周前的2月8日星期二，由戈夫斯拍卖行主办的大型马匹拍卖会在巴利曼尼西南22公里处的基尔村举行。

sentences.en: The auction attracted visitors from all over Ireland, with the typically quiet and peaceful area becoming a hive of activity
sentences.zh: 拍卖会吸引了来自爱尔兰各地的游客，原本宁静祥和的地区变得一片喧嚣，

sentences.en: as people, traffic and horse floats milled around well into the night.
sentences.zh: 人们、车辆和运马车一直穿梭到深夜。

sentences.en: As it was also nearly the breeding season, there were a greater number of horse floats around than usual as mares were moved to various stud farMs.
sentences.zh: 由于也接近繁殖季，随着母马被运往各个种马场，周围的运马车比平时更多。

sentences.en: February 8 was one of the coldest days Ireland had experienced that year, but was otherwise a regular day for Shurgar at the stud farm.
sentences.zh: 2月8日是爱尔兰当年经历的最冷的日子之一，但对种马场的谢加来说，这是平常的一天。

sentences.en: In the morning, he was taken out for exercise and later returned to his stable in the afternoon by Jim Fitzgerald.
sentences.zh: 早上，他被带出去锻炼，下午晚些时候由吉姆·菲茨杰拉德带回马厩。

sentences.en: That evening, Jim went home to eat dinner with his wife Madge and their six children, the youngest of whom was five years old.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，吉姆回家和妻子马奇以及他们的六个孩子吃晚饭，最小的孩子才五岁。

sentences.en: At 8pm, Jim returned to the Ballymanni stables to check that the horses were comfortable and settled.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点，吉姆回到巴利曼尼马厩检查马匹是否舒适安顿。

sentences.en: The night was cold and foggy, but everything seemed to be in order, so Jim walked back home.
sentences.zh: 夜晚又冷又起雾，但一切似乎都很正常，于是吉姆步行回家。

sentences.en: At around 8.40, Jim was upstairs when he heard knocking at his front door, which was unusual for that time of night.
sentences.zh: 大约8点40分，吉姆正在楼上时听到有人敲前门，这在那个时间的夜晚很不寻常。

sentences.en: Jim headed downstairs to see who it was, but his pre-teen son Bernard had already opened the door.
sentences.zh: 吉姆下楼去看看是谁，但他的预备少年儿子伯纳德已经打开了门。

sentences.en: Standing there was a tall man, dressed like the Garda, the name of the Irish Police Service, with a balaclava pulled over his head.
sentences.zh: 站在那里的是一个高个子男人，穿着爱尔兰警察部队加尔达的制服，头上套着巴拉克拉法帽。

sentences.en: Given how cold it was outside, it wasn't out of the ordinary to see a Garda officer wearing a balaclava.
sentences.zh: 鉴于外面天气那么冷，看到加尔达警官戴着巴拉克拉法帽并不罕见。

sentences.en: The man asked Bernard,
sentences.zh: 这个男人问伯纳德，

sentences.en: He turned to call for Jim, but as he did so, the man hit Bernard across his lower back, striking him to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他转身喊吉姆，但就在这时，那名男子击打伯纳德的下背部，将其击倒在地。

sentences.en: By the time Jim made it downstairs, the man had pinned Bernard to the floor with one hand.
sentences.zh: 等吉姆赶到楼下时，那名男子已经用一只手将伯纳德按在地板上。

sentences.en: In the other, he held a pistol, which he pointed towards Jim.
sentences.zh: 另一只手里，他握着一把手枪，指向吉姆。

sentences.en: At this point, two more balaclava-clad, pistol-wielding men entered the house and pointed their guns at the family.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，另外两个戴着巴拉克拉法帽、手持手枪的男人闯进屋里，用枪指着这一家人。

sentences.en: Another two assailants then burst through the door and ushered the children to a bedroom, while the other four took Jim and his wife Madge to the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 随后又有两名袭击者冲进门，把孩子们带到一间卧室，而另外四人则将吉姆和他的妻子马奇带到厨房。

sentences.en: Jim noted that the men were all very calm and organised and referred to one another using the code word,
sentences.zh: 吉姆注意到这些人都非常冷静且有条不紊，并用代号互相称呼，

sentences.en: Cresswell.
sentences.zh: 克雷斯韦尔。

sentences.en: It was obvious to him that the attack had been carefully planned.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这次袭击是经过精心策划的。

sentences.en: One of the men told Jim they had come for Shergar and demanded to be taken to him.
sentences.zh: 其中一人告诉吉姆他们是为谢加而来的，并要求带他们去找他。

sentences.en: They told Jim to get his coat and then marched him over to Ballymanee at gunpoint, while the other two armed men stayed at the house to keep an eye on the family.
sentences.zh: 他们让吉姆拿上外套，然后用枪指着他把他押到巴利曼尼，而另外两名武装男子则留在家里监视这一家人。

sentences.en: At 8.50pm,
sentences.zh: 晚上8点50分，

sentences.en: Jim and his attackers arrived at the stables.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和袭击者到达了马厩。

sentences.en: Jim believed that horses could sense the emotions of people they were familiar with and did his best to stay calm so as not to alarm Shergar.
sentences.zh: 吉姆相信马能感知它们熟悉的人的情绪，并尽力保持冷静以免惊动谢加。

sentences.en: It seemed to work as Shergar appeared relaxed and was easily led from his stable.
sentences.zh: 这似乎起作用了，谢加显得很放松，很容易就被牵出了马厩。

sentences.en: Still holding Jim at gunpoint, the men then demanded that he load Shergar into a horse float that was attached to a nearby car.
sentences.zh: 这些人依然用枪指着吉姆，随后要求他把谢加装上一辆停在附近汽车后面的运马车。

sentences.en: At this point,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Jim noticed that the men were carrying shortwave radios.
sentences.zh: 吉姆注意到这些人在携带短波无线电。

sentences.en: He also noted that one of the men seemed to have experience handling horses as he was more confident with his movements and less wary of Shergar than the others.
sentences.zh: 他还注意到其中一个人似乎有处理马匹的经验，因为他在动作时比其他人更自信，对谢加也没有那么戒备。

sentences.en: By nine o'clock,
sentences.zh: 到九点钟，

sentences.en: Jim had successfully loaded Shergar into the float.
sentences.zh: 吉姆已经成功将谢加装上了运马车。

sentences.en: Some of the thieves then got into the car and drove away as Jim watched helplessly.
sentences.zh: 随后一些小偷上了车开车离去，吉姆只能无助地看着。

sentences.en: The remaining men took Jim back to his house and kept him under watch until 10pm, at which point three of them loaded him into the back of a van and drove off.
sentences.zh: 剩下的人把吉姆带回他的家并看守他到晚上10点，当时其中三人把他塞进一辆面包车的后部并开车离去。

sentences.en: Jim was ordered to lie down with a coat over his face.
sentences.zh: 吉姆被命令躺下，脸上盖着一件外套。

sentences.en: His captors then drove over the rough country roads at high speeds, repeatedly warning Jim that he and his family would face violent ramifications if they went to the police.
sentences.zh: 他的绑架者随后以极高的速度开过颠簸的乡间小路，多次警告吉姆如果他们报警，他和他的家人将面临暴力后果。

sentences.en: After approximately two hours, they dropped Jim off at the side of a road about 48 kilometres northeast of Ballymane and gave him directions to the nearest town called Kilcock.
sentences.zh: 大约两个小时后，他们将吉姆在巴利曼尼东北约48公里处的一条路边放下，并指给他通往最近一个叫基尔科克的城镇的路。

sentences.en: The thieves told Jim they wanted two million pounds for Shergar's safe return and would be using the codename
sentences.zh: 那些小偷告诉吉姆，他们索要两百万英镑作为谢加安全归还的赎金，并将使用代号

sentences.en: King Neptune for upcoming ransom negotiations.
sentences.zh: 海王星来作为接下来进行赎金谈判的代号。

sentences.en: After telling Jim not to look back, they drove away into the night.
sentences.zh: 在嘱咐吉姆不要回头看之后，他们开车驶入了夜色中。

sentences.en: Terrified,
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分之中，

sentences.en: Jim walked to Kilcock, arriving just before midnight, and pounded on the door of a Chinese restaurant until the owners let him in.
sentences.zh: 吉姆步行前往基尔科克，在午夜前不久抵达，并疯狂砸着一家中餐馆的门，直到店主让他进去。

sentences.en: They allowed him to use their phone and Jim called his brother,
sentences.zh: 他们允许吉姆使用他们的电话，吉姆便打给了他的弟弟

sentences.en: Des Fitzgerald, who drove out to give him a lift back to Ballymane.
sentences.zh: 戴斯·菲茨杰拉德，后者开车出来接他回巴利马内。

sentences.en: By the time he arrived home, the armed men had left and his family were waiting up, shaken, but unharmed.
sentences.zh: 当他回到家时，那些持枪男子已经离开，他的家人正等着他，虽然惊魂未定，但所幸安然无恙。

sentences.en: At 12.10am on Wednesday February 9, as Jim was trying to come to terms with what had happened,
sentences.zh: 2月9日星期三凌晨12点10分，正当吉姆努力平复刚才发生的一切时，

sentences.en: Belfast-based horse breeders
sentences.zh: 总部位于贝尔法斯特的马匹繁育者

sentences.en: Jeremy and Judy Maxwell were awoken by a phone call.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞米和朱迪·麦克斯韦被一通电话吵醒。

sentences.en: Judy answered and a male on the other line introduced himself as King Neptune, saying,
sentences.zh: 朱迪接了电话，电话那头的一个男子自称为海王星，说道：

sentences.en: We've got Shergar.
sentences.zh: 我们已经抓了谢加。

sentences.en: If you want proof, we'll send you his ear.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要证据，我们就把它的耳朵寄给你。

sentences.en: Thinking it was a prank call,
sentences.zh: 以为这只是一通恶作剧电话，

sentences.en: Judy somewhat facetiously asked the men to take good care of the horse.
sentences.zh: 朱迪带有几分戏谑地请这些人好好照顾这匹马。

sentences.en: She then hung up and went back to sleep, without giving the call much more thought.
sentences.zh: 随后她便挂断电话重新入睡，没有把这通电话太放在心上。

sentences.en: 20 minutes later, at 12.30am, the phone rang at the BBC television office in BelfaSt.
sentences.zh: 20分钟后，即凌晨12点30分，贝尔法斯特的英国广播公司电视办公室的电话响了。

sentences.en: The employee who answered heard the voice of a well-educated-sounding man with a Southern Irish accent.
sentences.zh: 接听电话的员工听到一个带有南爱尔兰口音、听起来很有教养的男子的声音。

sentences.en: He told the employee that Shergar had been kidnapped and the captors were only willing to negotiate with Britain's three best racing journalists,
sentences.zh: 他告诉这名员工，谢加被绑架了，绑匪只愿意与英国三位顶尖的赛马记者进行谈判，

sentences.en: Derek Thompson,
sentences.zh: 他们是德里克·汤普森、

sentences.en: John Oakesy, and Peter Campling.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥克斯和彼得·坎普林。

sentences.en: He ordered that the trio be at the Europa Hotel in central Belfast by the evening of Thursday,
sentences.zh: 他命令这三人必须在周四晚上赶到贝尔法斯特市中心的欧罗巴酒店，

sentences.en: February 10, and said that on future calls he would identify himself as Zarkle, which was the name of another famous racehorse.
sentences.zh: 即2月10日，并表示在以后的通话中他会自称为扎克尔，这也是另一匹著名赛马的名字。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, at Bally Mani,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在巴利马内，

sentences.en: Jim Fitzgerald was contemplating what to do next.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·菲茨杰拉德正在思索接下来该怎么做。

sentences.en: At 1.15am, he called his boss,
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点15分，他给自己的老板打了电话，

sentences.en: Gilla Drion, who was the stud manager for the Aga Khan's
sentences.zh: 吉拉·德里翁，他是阿加汗

sentences.en: Irish studs, and told him what had happened.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰牧场的场长，并把发生的事情告诉了他。

sentences.en: Gilla wanted to phone the guarder, but Jim warned him not to, so Gilla called the Aga Khan in Switzerland instead.
sentences.zh: 吉拉想报警，但吉姆警告他不要这么做，于是吉拉转而打电话给在瑞士的阿加汗。

sentences.en: Unable to get a hold of him, he then called
sentences.zh: 在联系不上他之后，吉拉接着打给了

sentences.en: Shergar's vet and shareholder,
sentences.zh: 谢加的兽医兼股东

sentences.en: Stan Cosgrove.
sentences.zh: 斯坦·科斯格罗夫。

sentences.en: The two men drove to Bally Mani to speak with Jim in person and to confirm that Shergar really had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 这两名男子开车前往巴利马内亲自与吉姆交谈，并确认谢加确实被偷了。

sentences.en: Stan Cosgrove soon phoned his friend,
sentences.zh: 斯坦·科斯格罗夫不久后给他的朋友打了电话，

sentences.en: Captain Sean Berry, the manager of the Irish
sentences.zh: 肖恩·贝里上尉，爱尔兰

sentences.en: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association, and told him what had happened.
sentences.zh: 纯血马繁育者协会的经理，并将发生的事情告诉了他。

sentences.en: Captain Berry later told author
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉后来告诉作家

sentences.en: Milton C.
sentences.zh: 米尔顿·C·

sentences.en: Toby that in his business, the telephone call from Stan Cosgrove was, quote,
sentences.zh: 托比，在他的行当里，斯坦·科斯格罗夫打来的那通电话，用他的话说，

sentences.en: the equivalent of the director of the Louvre in Paris being told that the Mona Lisa had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 就相当于巴黎卢浮宫的馆长被人告知《蒙娜丽莎》被偷了一样。

sentences.en: At 1.45am, racing journalist
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点45分，赛马记者

sentences.en: Derek Thompson awoke to a phone call in his London hotel room.
sentences.zh: 德里克·汤普森在伦敦的酒店房间里被一通电话吵醒。

sentences.en: It was a reporter from London's press association who advised Derek that Shergar had been kidnapped and the captors had asked to speak with him personally.
sentences.zh: 打电话的是伦敦新闻社的一名记者，他通知德里克说谢加被绑架了，绑匪要求亲自与他交谈。

sentences.en: Derek didn't believe this at first, but the reporter repeatedly told him that it was not a joke.
sentences.zh: 德里克起初不相信这件事，但该记者一再告诉他这不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Derek eventually agreed to accompany the other two racing journalists,
sentences.zh: 德里克最终同意在次日晚上陪同另外两名赛马记者

sentences.en: John Oakesy and Peter Campling, to Belfast the following evening to negotiate
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥克斯和彼得·坎普林前往贝尔法斯特，以谈判

sentences.en: Shergar's release.
sentences.zh: 释放谢加的事宜。

sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后将继续播出。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《罪案档案》继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: By 4am,
sentences.zh: 到了凌晨4点，

sentences.en: Gila Drion had managed to get hold of the Aga Khan in Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 吉拉·德里翁设法联系上了远在瑞士的阿加汗。

sentences.en: Gila asked whether they should simply pay the ransom quietly without getting the police involved, but the Aga Khan instructed him to notify the guarder.
sentences.zh: 吉拉询问是否应该在不惊动警方的情况下悄悄支付赎金，但阿加汗指示他必须报警。

sentences.en: He reasoned that there were too many shareholders involved with Shergar for him to make a decision on his own and it was inevitable that the guarder and press would learn about
sentences.zh: 他推断，涉及谢加的股东太多，他无法独自做出决定，而且警方和媒体无论如何最终都会得知

sentences.en: the theft anyway.
sentences.zh: 这起盗窃案。

sentences.en: The Aga Khan also said that there was no guarantee that Shergar would be returned safely even if they paid the ransom and that paying could set a precedent for further thefts
sentences.zh: 阿加汗还表示，即使他们支付了赎金，也无法保证谢加能安全归还，而且付赎金可能会为以后绑架

sentences.en: of Irish racehorses.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰赛马的案件开创先例。

sentences.zh: 2月16日星期三，宪兵发布了一名目击者的描述，称在谢加失踪当晚8点30分，有一辆运马拖车被发现离开巴利马尼牧场。

sentences.en: It was described as either a light blue or light green two-horse trailer that was possibly manufactured by a company called Rice.
sentences.zh: 据描述，这是一辆浅蓝色或浅绿色的双马拖车，可能是由一家名为赖斯的公司制造的。

sentences.en: It was in rough condition, with no license plate or working lights, and was being towed by either a Brown Hillman
sentences.zh: 它的状况很糟糕，没有车牌或正常工作的车灯，由一辆棕色的希尔曼

sentences.en: Hunter or a Vauxhall.
sentences.zh: 亨特或沃克斯豪尔汽车牵引。

sentences.en: Following the release of this information, investigators were optimistic that the float would be identified, but their hopes were quashed when no leads arose.
sentences.zh: 随着这些信息的发布，调查人员对能够识别这辆拖车持乐观态度，但当没有任何线索出现时，他们的希望破灭了。

sentences.en: Later that day, Chief Murphy stepped down from handling the press briefings, instead assigning the task to
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，墨菲局长不再负责处理新闻发布会，而是将此任务交给了

sentences.en: Superintendent Noel Anderson, an experienced spokesperson and senior press officer.
sentences.zh: 诺埃尔·安德森总警司，他是一位经验丰富的发言人和高级新闻官员。

sentences.en: Although he never confirmed why, it was likely that Chief Murphy stepped down due to the media's constant ridicule.
sentences.zh: 虽然他从未确认原因，但墨菲局长卸任很可能是因为媒体的不断嘲弄。

sentences.en: On Saturday February 19, a loaded magazine cartridge from an automatic rifle was found near the entrance of
sentences.zh: 2月19日星期六，在

sentences.zh: 巴利马尼牧场

sentences.en: It was from a Steyr Daimler Puck, an

sentences.en: Austrian submachine gun that was rare in
sentences.zh: 它来自斯泰尔-戴姆勒-普赫，这是一种在

sentences.zh: 爱尔兰共和军南部司令部支部中广为人知的奥地利冲锋枪。

sentences.en: The guarder were unable to lift any fingerprints off the magazine or link it to an owner, and ultimately decided to withhold the discovery from the public.
sentences.zh: 警察无法从弹匣上提取任何指纹，也无法将其与所有人联系起来，最终决定向公众隐瞒这一发现。

sentences.en: The days continued to pass without any further contact from Shergar's captors.
sentences.zh: 日子一天天过去，谢加的绑架者再也没有与他们联系。

sentences.en: The shareholders tried to re-establish communication with the thieves via the media, but their attempts were unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 股东们试图通过媒体与绑匪重新建立联系，但他们的尝试均告失败。

sentences.en: They believed that Shergar would eventually be released unharmed, as they couldn't imagine that a fellow
sentences.zh: 他们相信谢加最终会被无伤害地释放，因为他们无法想象同胞

sentences.en: Irishman would kill an innocent horse and beloved national treasure.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰人会杀死一匹无辜的马和受人爱戴的国家宝藏。

sentences.en: However, weeks went by without any leads or breakthroughs in the case, and the investigation and media reports started slowing down.
sentences.zh: 然而，几周过去了，案件没有任何线索或突破，调查和媒体报道开始放缓。

sentences.en: The public were eager to help, with
sentences.zh: 公众渴望提供帮助，

sentences.zh: 15万民众加入搜寻队伍，检查田野、农场和马厩。

sentences.en: The guarder followed every tip-off they received, searching canal banks, travellers' caravans, and properties, only to find out that several of the tip-offs were
sentences.zh: 警察跟进了他们收到的每一个线索，搜查了运河岸边、旅行者的房车和房产，结果却发现其中几个线索是

sentences.en: hoaxes crafted by vengeful neighbours.
sentences.zh: 由怀恨在心的邻居精心策划的恶作剧。

sentences.en: In a bid to gather information, detectives interviewed more than 100 jockeys from
sentences.zh: 为了收集情报，侦探们采访了来自

sentences.zh: 爱尔兰和英格兰的100多名骑师，警察澄清说，这些采访与其中一名嫌疑人被描述为骑师没有任何关系。

sentences.en: From an economic point of view, the theft of
sentences.zh: 从经济角度来看，

sentences.en: Shergar was a huge problem for Ireland.
sentences.zh: 谢加被盗对爱尔兰来说是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Not only did the horse racing industry provide
sentences.zh: 赛马业不仅为国内提供了

sentences.en: 20,000 jobs within the country, but it also generated lots of money from international sources.
sentences.zh: 2万个就业岗位，还从国际渠道创造了大量资金。

sentences.en: With the crime casting doubt on the safety of the industry, the Irish economy was at risk of impact.
sentences.zh: 由于这起犯罪给该行业的安全蒙上了阴影，爱尔兰经济面临着受到冲击的风险。

sentences.en: Chief Murphy told the press, quote,
sentences.zh: 墨菲局长对记者说，原话是：

sentences.en: If any harm happens to that horse, it is going to do the industry an amount of anguish in
sentences.zh: 如果这匹马受到任何伤害，将给这个国家的赛马业带来巨大的痛苦，

sentences.en: this country, and for that reason alone, I would ask the kidnappers to return the horse safely.
sentences.zh: 仅凭这一点，我就恳请绑匪安全归还这匹马。

sentences.en: As the guarder grew increasingly desperate, they sought the help of around 50 clairvoyants, which drew further ridicule from the press.
sentences.zh: 随着警察越来越绝望，他们寻求了大约50名千里眼（灵媒）的帮助，这引来媒体更多的嘲笑。

sentences.en: A majority of the psychics believed that Shergar would be found west of the River Shannon in
sentences.zh: 大多数通灵者认为谢加会被发现在

sentences.en: County Galway, which investigators believed was too compelling to ignore.
sentences.zh: 戈尔韦郡香农河以西，调查人员认为这一说法极具说服力，不容忽视。

sentences.en: They searched this area with the help of several psychics, but nothing was found.
sentences.zh: 他们在几名通灵者的协助下搜查了这一地区，但一无所获。

sentences.en: In early March, a man named Patrick Kelly recognised the description of the horse float used in
sentences.zh: 3月上旬，一名叫帕特里克·凯利的男子认出了绑架

sentences.en: Shergar's kidnapping as his own float that was stolen in County Louth, near the border of Northern
sentences.zh: 谢加时使用的运马拖车，正是他自己在北爱尔兰

sentences.en: Ireland.
sentences.zh: 边境附近的劳斯郡被盗的那辆。

sentences.en: He provided photos of the float, and Jim Fitzgerald positively identified it as the one used by the thieves to transport Shergar.
sentences.zh: 他提供了拖车的照片，吉姆·菲茨杰拉德确认这就是绑匪用来运送谢加的那辆。

sentences.en: What seemed like a big breakthrough ultimately led nowhere, as Patrick Kelly was unable to provide any further insight into who might have stolen the float.
sentences.zh: 这个看似巨大的突破最终却陷入死胡同，因为帕特里克·凯利无法提供关于谁可能偷了这辆拖车的更多见解。

sentences.en: The hotline that had been set up by Captain Sean Berry, manager of the Irish Thoroughbred
sentences.zh: 由爱尔兰纯种马

sentences.en: Breeders Association, remained active, and on March 16, he received a call from a man with a cultured
sentences.zh: breeders协会经理肖恩·贝里上尉设立的热线电话仍然保持畅通，3月16日，他接到了一名带有文雅的

sentences.en: Irish accent who requested a £250,000 reward to begin negotiations for Shergar's safe return.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰口音的男子的电话，该男子要求25万英镑的悬赏，以便开始就谢加的安全归还进行谈判。

sentences.en: Captain Berry agreed to get the money together, and the caller said he would be in touch again soon, using the codename Rugby.
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉同意凑齐这笔钱，来电者表示很快会再次联系他，并使用代号“橄榄球”。

sentences.en: This codename concerned Captain Berry, as he was a huge Rugby fan, and became paranoid that the caller may have been monitoring his personal life or watching his family.
sentences.zh: 这个代号让贝里上尉感到担忧，因为他是个超级橄榄球迷，这让他开始产生偏执，担心来电者可能一直在监视他的私生活或观察他的家人。

sentences.en: He notified the garter, and on March 24, Rugby called again.
sentences.zh: 他通知了宪兵，3月24日，“橄榄球”再次打来电话。

sentences.en: Captain Berry told him the reward money would only be paid if he received conclusive evidence that Shergar was still alive, to which
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉告诉他，只有在收到确凿证据证明谢加仍然活着的情况下，才会支付悬赏金，对此

sentences.en: Rugby said he would be in touch.
sentences.zh: “橄榄球”表示他会保持联系。

sentences.en: Captain Berry and his wife were scheduled to depart for a two-week holiday in the Canary Islands, but they told the garter they'd be happy to cancel the trip in order to
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉和妻子原计划前往加那利群岛进行为期两周的度假，但他们告诉宪兵，为了

sentences.en: stay home to continue negotiations.
sentences.zh: 留在家里继续谈判，他们很乐意取消行程。

sentences.en: The garter urged the couple to carry on with their plans, and while they were on holiday, no further calls came through.
sentences.zh: 宪兵敦促这对夫妇按计划行事，在他们度假期间，再也没有电话打进来。

sentences.en: This added to Captain Berry's suspicion that he was under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 这加深了贝里上尉对自己在被监视的怀疑。

sentences.en: The next phone call from Rugby came on the morning of May 2, 1983.
sentences.zh: “橄榄球”打来的下一个电话是在1983年5月2日上午。

sentences.en: This time he directed Captain Berry to drive to the Caydean Hotel in Newbridge, near Ballymany Stud, to wait for an incoming phone call for a Mr Davies.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他指示贝里上尉开车前往巴利马尼牧场附近的纽布里奇的凯代恩酒店，等待一个转给戴维斯先生的来电。

sentences.en: Captain Berry did as he was told, with undercover garter officers also positioning themselves inside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉照做了，便衣宪兵也提前在酒店内部部署好了位置。

sentences.en: At 11am, the phone rang for Mr Davies and Captain Berry answered as directed.
sentences.zh: 上午11点，转给戴维斯先生的电话响了，贝里上尉按指示接了电话。

sentences.en: Rugby instructed him to return to the hotel the following afternoon with £250,000 in cash, at which point he would be taken to see Shergar.
sentences.zh: “橄榄球”指示他第二天下午带着25万英镑现金返回酒店，届时他将被带去见谢加。

sentences.en: Captain Berry went home and obtained a blood testing kit from a local Leckwine DNA testing facility.
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉回家，并从当地的莱克温DNA检测机构获取了一套血液检测工具。

sentences.en: He returned to the hotel on the afternoon of May 3, where the phone rang at approximately 2 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 他在5月3日下午返回酒店，电话大约在两点钟响了。

sentences.en: This time, Rugby advised Captain Berry to travel to a payphone in Kildare at 9pm on May 5, where arrangements would be made to take him to Shergar.
sentences.zh: 这一次，“橄榄球”通知贝里上尉于5月5日晚上9点前往基尔代尔的一个公用电话亭，届时将安排人员带他去找谢加。

sentences.en: Undercover officers noted a man who had also been at the hotel the day prior was watching Captain Berry closely, which confirmed their suspicion that he was under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 便衣警官注意到，前一天也在酒店的一名男子正在密切注视着贝里上尉，这证实了他们关于他正在被监视的怀疑。

sentences.en: They warned him to cease the negotiations if he feared his family was in danger, but Captain
sentences.zh: 他们警告他，如果担心家人处于危险之中，就停止谈判，但贝里

sentences.en: Berry wanted to persevere in the hopes of Shergar's return.
sentences.zh: 上尉为了谢加能够归还的希望，想要坚持下去。

sentences.en: At 8.57pm on May 5, he went to the phone booth in Kildare and waited for the call.
sentences.zh: 5月5日晚上8点57分，他来到基尔代尔的电话亭等待电话。

sentences.en: Rugby rang one hour later, asking Captain Berry if he would be willing to be held with Shergar while positive identification was made and the reward money was handed over.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，“橄榄球”打来电话，询问贝里上尉是否愿意在确认身份并交付悬赏金期间与谢加关押在一起。

sentences.en: Captain Berry agreed, but said that vet Stan Cosgrove would have to accompany him to facilitate the necessary identity testing.
sentences.zh: 贝里上尉表示同意，但说兽医斯坦·科斯格罗夫必须陪同他以协助进行必要的身份测试。

sentences.en: Rugby said he would check and call back shortly.
sentences.zh: “橄榄球”说他会查看一下，稍后回电。

sentences.en: But Captain Berry waited and waited, and no further calls came through.
sentences.zh: 但贝里上尉等了又等，再也没有电话打进来。

sentences.en: He never heard from Rugby again, and the reward remained unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 他再也没有听到“橄榄球”的消息，悬赏金也无人认领。

sentences.en: Shortly after this, a member of the Garda named Officer Kearnians contacted Stan Cosgrove,
sentences.zh: 此后不久，一名叫卡尼安斯警官的加尔达成员联系了斯坦·科斯格罗夫，

sentences.en: wanting to introduce him to Dennis Minogue, a well-known horse dealer with an interesting story to tell.
sentences.zh: 想把他介绍给丹尼斯·米诺格，一个有着引人入胜故事的著名马匹贩子。

sentences.en: Dennis told Stan that intermediaries of Shergar's captors had shown him a photo of Shergar, then placed a hood
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯告诉斯坦，谢加绑架者的中间人给他看了一张谢加的照片，然后把头套

sentences.en: over his head and drove him to an unknown location in the Irish countryside, where he saw Shergar alive.
sentences.zh: 套在他头上，把他开车带到爱尔兰乡村的一个未知地点，在那里他见到了活着的谢加。

sentences.en: Stan asked Dennis if £80,000 would be enough to have Shergar returned safely with no questions asked.
sentences.zh: 斯坦问丹尼斯，8万英镑是否足够让谢加安全返回且不问任何问题。

sentences.en: Dennis agreed to speak to the intermediaries, who in turn agreed to the deal.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯同意与中间人交谈，中间人随后同意了这笔交易。

sentences.en: Through Dennis, the thieves directed Stan to place £80,000 cash into the boot of Dennis's car, along with a £10,000 finder's fee for Dennis.
sentences.zh: 通过丹尼斯，绑匪指示斯坦将8万英镑现金放入丹尼斯的汽车后备箱，并为丹尼斯提供1万英镑的寻人费。

sentences.en: They were then instructed to drive the car to the village of Aatna Krasa in County Clare and leave it in a specified remote location.
sentences.zh: 然后他们被指示将车开到克莱尔郡的阿特纳克拉萨村，并将其停在指定的偏远地点。

sentences.en: There, the thieves would remove the money and replace it with instructions on how to retrieve Shergar.
sentences.zh: 在那里，绑匪会拿走钱，并换成如何找回谢加的指示。

sentences.en: Officer Kearnians agreed to accompany Stan and Dennis in the hopes of catching the thieves in a sting operation.
sentences.zh: 卡尼安斯警官同意陪同斯坦和丹尼斯，希望能通过钓鱼执法抓获绑匪。

sentences.en: The trio followed the instructions, leaving Dennis's car in the specified location with £90,000 cash in the boot and then left the scene.
sentences.zh: 三人按照指示行事，将丹尼斯的车留在指定地点，后备箱里有9万英镑现金，然后离开了现场。

sentences.en: They returned a short while later and found that the money had been taken, but there were no instructions regarding getting Shergar back.
sentences.zh: 他们不久后返回，发现钱已经被拿走了，但没有任何关于如何找回谢加的指示。

sentences.en: Upon realising that the whole plot had been a set-up, Stan was convinced Officer Kearnians had been involved from the get-go.
sentences.zh: 意识到整个阴谋是一个局后，斯坦确信卡尼安斯警官从一开始就牵涉其中。

sentences.en: Officer Kearnians was investigated by the garter and eventually sacked for carrying out under the table police operations.
sentences.zh: 卡尼安斯警官接受了宪兵的调查，最终因进行私下警察行动而被解雇。

sentences.en: Dennis Minogue remained adamant that the horse he'd been shown was Shergar, and opinions differ as to whether he and Officer Kearnians were part of the set-up or had been fooled
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·米诺格坚称他看到的马就是谢加，至于他和卡尼安斯警官是局中人还是自己也被骗了，

sentences.en: themselves.
sentences.zh: 人们的看法不一。

sentences.en: The months continued to pass with no major breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 时间一天天过去，没有取得任何重大突破。

sentences.en: By September 1983, mares that had been lined up to breed with Shergar in the 1984 breeding season began arriving at Ballymani Stard,
sentences.zh: 到1983年9月，原定于1984年配种季节与谢加配种的母马开始陆续抵达巴利马尼牧场，

sentences.en: where they were to be boarded until definitive news regarding Shergar emerged.
sentences.zh: 它们将在那里寄养，直到关于谢加的确切消息出现。

sentences.en: From the outset of the investigation, the guard suspected that the IRA was involved in stealing Shergar.
sentences.zh: 从调查一开始，警察就怀疑爱尔兰共和军参与了盗窃谢加的行动。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1970s, the IRA had started receiving weapons and training from international supporters, including sympathisers from the United States, Libya and Palestine.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪70年代，爱尔兰共和军开始从国际支持者那里获得武器和训练，其中包括来自美国、利比亚和巴勒斯坦的同情者。

sentences.en: However, their campaigns were costly and the amount of money coming in via donations and illegal activities wasn't enough to fund their violent protests, equipment,
sentences.zh: 然而，他们的行动代价高昂，通过捐款和非法活动筹集的资金根本不足以为他们的暴力抗议、装备、

sentences.en: weapons and explosives.
sentences.zh: 武器以及炸药提供资金。

sentences.en: By the 1980s, the FBI was conducting an ongoing investigation into American support of the IRA, which meant there had been a halt on weapons procured from the USA.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代，美国联邦调查局正在对美国支持爱尔兰共和军（IRA）的行为进行持续调查，这意味着从美国采购的武器已被切断。

sentences.en: Consequently, the IRA was in financial strife and began resorting to kidnapping for ransom as a means of income, with varying levels of success.
sentences.zh: 因此，爱尔兰共和军陷入了财务困境，开始诉诸绑架勒索赎金来作为收入来源，不过成效时好时坏。

sentences.en: In October 1981, the IRA had kidnapped wealthy supermarket executive
sentences.zh: 1981年10月，爱尔兰共和军绑架了富有的超市高管

sentences.en: Ben Dunn after he pulled over in his car to offer assistance at a staged accident.
sentences.zh: 本·邓恩（Ben Dunn），当时他将车停在路边，试图在一场精心策划的车祸现场提供帮助。

sentences.en: Ben was held hostage for six days while negotiations were made for a £1.5 million ransom to be paid.
sentences.zh: 本被扣为人质六天，期间双方就支付150万英镑的赎金展开了谈判。

sentences.en: His family wanted to pay the ransom but were blocked by the guard, prompting Ben's property manager to pay instead to secure Ben's safe release.
sentences.zh: 他的家人想要支付赎金，但受到了警卫的阻挠，这促使本的物业经理出面代为支付，以确保本安全获释。

sentences.en: This kidnapping set a crucial precedent as the IRA earned a lucrative ransom without any consequences.
sentences.zh: 这次绑架开创了一个关键的先例，因为爱尔兰共和军在没有任何后果的情况下勒索到了一笔丰厚的赎金。

sentences.en: In August 1983, six months after Shergar was stolen, seven armed IRA members stormed the South Dublin house
sentences.zh: 1983年8月，在谢加（Shergar）被盗六个月后，七名武装爱尔兰共和军成员闯入了都柏林南部的一处宅邸，

sentences.en: of Galen Weston, the wealthy president of a Canadian supermarket chain, intending to kidnap him for ransom.
sentences.zh: 该宅邸属于加拿大一家连锁超市的富有总裁盖伦·韦斯顿（Galen Weston），他们企图绑架他以勒索赎金。

sentences.en: The guard had already received a tip-off that Galen might be a target and were waiting inside to arrest them.
sentences.zh: 警卫此前已经得到了盖伦可能是目标的线索，并一直在里面等待着逮捕他们。

sentences.en: A gunfight ensued, with five of the perpetrators taken into custody for attempted kidnapping, while two escaped.
sentences.zh: 双方随即爆发枪战，其中五名歹徒因企图绑架被拘留，另外两人逃脱。

sentences.en: Investigators believed these were the same individuals who had stolen Shergar, but they denied any involvement with the case.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为这些人就是偷走谢加的同一伙人，但他们否认与此案有任何牵连。

sentences.en: Three months later, the IRA abducted one of Galen's employees, a widowed father of four named Don Tidy.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，爱尔兰共和军绑架了盖伦的一名员工，一个带着四个孩子的丧妻父亲，名叫唐·蒂迪（Don Tidy）。

sentences.en: Don was driving his teenage daughter to school in the
sentences.zh: 当时唐正开车带着他十几岁的女儿前往位于

sentences.en: Dublin suburb of Rathbarnham when IRA members posing as the guarder pulled him over and shoved him in the boot of their fake police car.
sentences.zh: 都柏林郊区拉思法尔汉姆（Rathbarnham）的学校，伪装成警卫的爱尔兰共和军成员将他拦下，并把他塞进他们那辆假警车的后备箱里。

sentences.en: After a 22-day long investigation, Don was found unharmed with his captors in a wooded area of County Leitrim and a shootout followed, resulting in the deaths of a guarder trainee
sentences.zh: 经过长达22天的调查，人们在利特里姆郡（County Leitrim）的一片林区发现了安然无恙的唐以及他的绑架者，随后双方爆发枪战，导致一名见习警卫

sentences.en: and an army private.
sentences.zh: 和一名陆军列兵身亡。

sentences.en: The general consensus was that the IRA took Shergar as they had the motive and means to carry out the theft.
sentences.zh: 普遍的共识是，爱尔兰共和军偷走了谢加，因为他们有动机也有能力实施这起盗窃。

sentences.en: But when the IRA didn't claim responsibility, some people doubted their involvement in the plan, as they had always admitted to all their other kidnappings.
sentences.zh: 但当爱尔兰共和军没有认领责任时，一些人开始怀疑他们是否参与其中，因为他们对所有其他绑架事件都供认不讳。

sentences.en: Moreover, at the time Shergar was taken, a number of British intelligence agents had infiltrated the IRA, and it was expected that one of
sentences.zh: 此外，在谢加被盗时，许多英国情报人员已经渗透进爱尔兰共和军，人们原本预计其中

sentences.en: them would have surely heard about the plan.
sentences.zh: 肯定有人会听到这个计划。

sentences.en: Those who suspected the IRA was responsible have argued that
sentences.zh: 那些怀疑爱尔兰共和军是幕后黑手的人认为，

sentences.en: British intelligence might have known, but didn't speak up out of fear of putting their lives in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 英国情报部门可能早就知道了，但由于害怕危及生命而没有说出来。

sentences.en: It's also been suggested that the IRA may have never owned up to the crime because the public outrage
sentences.zh: 还有人推测，爱尔兰共和军可能从未承认过这桩罪行，因为公众对

sentences.en: over Shergar's theft was so much more intense than the reaction to IRA kidnappings of people.
sentences.zh: 谢加被盗的愤怒，远比对爱尔兰共和军绑架平民事件的反应要强烈得多。

sentences.en: It was argued that the IRA kept it a secret because they feared a huge backlash from the Irish community over the theft of the beloved horse.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，爱尔兰共和军之所以将其秘而不宣，是因为他们害怕偷走这匹备受喜爱的赛马会招致爱尔兰社区的猛烈强力反弹。

sentences.en: By the end of 1983, insurance companies began to pay out
sentences.zh: 到1983年底，保险公司开始向

sentences.en: Shergar's various shareholders for their losses.
sentences.zh: 谢加的各个股东赔偿他们的损失。

sentences.en: Most of the shareholders had taken out insurance with
sentences.zh: 大多数股东都在

sentences.en: Lloyds of London for over £10 million, which included coverage for Shergar's death as a result of accident, sickness or disease.
sentences.zh: 劳合社（Lloyds of London）投保了超过1000万英镑的保险，其中包括承保谢加因意外、疾病或生病而死亡的保障。

sentences.en: Twenty of the shareholders had also paid extra premiums to cover theft, which resulted in each of them receiving a payout of £7 million.
sentences.zh: 其中二十名股东还支付了额外的保费来承保盗窃险，这使得他们每人获得了700万英镑的赔偿金。

sentences.en: Those who didn't have coverage for theft didn't receive any payouts, as it couldn't be proved whether or not Shergar was dead, and therefore
sentences.zh: 那些没有购买盗窃险的人没有获得任何赔偿，因为无法证明谢加是否已经死亡，因此

sentences.en: the insurance companies weren't obliged to pay.
sentences.zh: 保险公司没有义务理赔。

sentences.en: Some of the wealthier shareholders took the issue to court, but their claims were unsuccessful, which discredited some lingering theories that Shergar's
sentences.zh: 一些比较富裕的股东将此案告上法庭，但他们的索赔并未成功，这也打破了一些挥之不去的理论，即谢加的

sentences.en: theft was an inside job orchestrated by the shareholders in a bid to collect large insurance payouts.
sentences.zh: 失窃是股东们为了骗取巨额保险金而自导自演的内部作案。

sentences.en: By 1984, the case had gone cold, and on February 6, just prior to the commencement of the breeding season, the shareholders and Aga Khan released their first official statement.
sentences.zh: 到了1984年，该案已成悬案。2月6日，就在繁殖季开始前夕，股东们和阿迦汗（Aga Khan）发布了他们的第一份官方声明。

sentences.en: They confirmed their belief that the IRA was responsible for the crime, and that Shergar had been killed shortly after he was
sentences.zh: 他们确认自己坚信爱尔兰共和军是这起罪行的幕后黑手，并且谢加在被盗后不久就

sentences.en: stolen, describing his chances of being alive as remote.
sentences.zh: 已经被杀害，并称他生还的几率微乎其微。

sentences.en: Eighteen months after Shergar's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 在谢加失踪十八个月后，

sentences.en: Chief Inspector James Murphy told the Washington Post, quote,
sentences.zh: 总督察詹姆斯·墨菲（James Murphy）对《华盛顿邮报》表示，原话如下：

sentences.en: You have to take into account more serious things.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到更严重的事情。

sentences.en: A person's life is involved in a murder, not a horse's.
sentences.zh: 人命关天，这涉及谋杀，而不是一匹马。

sentences.en: But we keep looking.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍在继续搜寻。

sentences.en: You can never feel dispirited, though you have to take into account the lapse of time.
sentences.zh: 你永远不能气馁，尽管你必须把时间的推移考虑在内。

sentences.en: We follow up on anything.
sentences.zh: 我们会跟进任何线索。

sentences.en: You can't call the case closed until it is.
sentences.zh: 在案件尘埃落定之前，你不能说它已经结案。

sentences.en: Theories continued to abound as to Shergar's fate.
sentences.zh: 关于谢加的最终命运，各种猜测依然层出不穷。

sentences.en: Some believed he was held in a private farm until the story died down, at which point he was disguised and raced under a different name in order to win money for his captors.
sentences.zh: 有人认为他被藏在一个私人农场里，直到风头过去，届时他会被伪装起来，并改名换姓参加比赛，为绑架者赢取奖金。

sentences.en: This theory held little credit, as there was no guarantee that
sentences.zh: 这个理论站不住脚，因为经过多年没有训练的状态，

sentences.en: Shergar would have performed after several years without training, and nor could he have been disguised well enough to prevent people from recognising him.
sentences.zh: 谢加根本无法保证还能有好的表现，而且他也无法伪装得好到能让人认不出他来。

sentences.en: Another theory was that Shergar had been stolen for breeding purposes.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，谢加被偷是为了进行繁殖育种。

sentences.en: This too was easily dismissed, as the profits derived from breeding with a famous racehorse came almost entirely from the name attached to the horse.
sentences.zh: 这个说法同样很快被否定了，因为从与一匹著名赛马进行繁殖中获得的利润，几乎完全取决于这匹马所附带的名气。

sentences.en: Without revealing that
sentences.zh: 如果不公开透露

sentences.en: Shergar was the father, any offspring he bore would be worth a fraction of the coSt.
sentences.zh: 谢加是父亲，他所生下的任何后代其价值也只是九牛一毛。

sentences.en: Some believed a Middle Eastern sheikh had stolen Shergar to breed his own successful racehorses,
sentences.zh: 有人认为某个中东谢赫偷走了谢加来繁育他自己成功的赛马，

sentences.en: but this theory was also dismissed given the sheer effort it would have taken to secretly transport the horse internationally.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到秘密将马匹国际运输所需付出的巨大努力，这个理论也被排除了。

sentences.en: Authorities did investigate this claim, but found no evidence to suggest a horse had been chartered out of the country by sea or air around the time of Shergar's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 当局确实调查了这一说法，但没有发现任何证据表明在谢加失踪前后有马匹通过海运或空运被包机运出国外。

sentences.en: It was also speculated that the mafia may have been responsible.
sentences.zh: 也有人猜测，黑手党可能是幕后黑手。

sentences.en: In the months before Shergar's theft, a French bloodstock agent named Jean-Michael Gambit, who was living in the United States,
sentences.zh: 在谢加被盗的前几个月，一名住在美国的法国纯血马经纪人，名叫让-米歇尔·甘比（Jean-Michael Gambit），

sentences.en: had been in talks with the Aga Khan about purchasing a racehorse.
sentences.zh: 一直在与阿迦汗就购买一匹赛马进行洽谈。

sentences.en: It was speculated that Jean-Michael didn't have the money to buy the horse up front, so he obtained a loan of half a million dollars from the New Orleans Mafia.
sentences.zh: 据猜测，让-米歇尔没有足够的现金直接买下这匹马，于是他向新奥尔良黑手党贷款了五十万美元。

sentences.en: The deal with the Aga Khan then fell through, but Jean-Michael had already spent the money and couldn't afford to repay the mafia.
sentences.zh: 后来与阿迦汗的交易告吹了，但让-米歇尔已经花光了这笔钱，根本无力偿还黑手党。

sentences.en: On December 13 1982, Jean-Michael was shot dead in his car and the vehicle sat alight.
sentences.zh: 1982年12月13日，让-米歇尔被枪杀在自己的车内，车辆随之被纵火焚烧。

sentences.en: The theory was that he had been killed by the mafia, who then stole
sentences.zh: 当时的推测是，他被黑手党杀害，黑手党随后偷走了

sentences.en: Shergar as a means of repayment.
sentences.zh: 谢加作为偿还债务的手段。

sentences.en: However, the police ruled that Jean-Michael's death was a suicide and he had
sentences.zh: 然而，警方裁定让-米歇尔之死属于自杀，而且他

sentences.en: staged the crime scene to look like a murder so his family could collect from his multiple life insurance policies.
sentences.zh: 伪造了谋杀现场，以便其家人能够从他多份人寿保险中获得赔偿。

sentences.en: Neither the authorities nor the Aga Khan believed the two incidents were related.
sentences.zh: 无论是当局还是阿迦汗，都不认为这两起事件有什么关联。

sentences.en: At one point, it was even speculated that Libyan political leader Colonel Muammar al-Gaddafi was responsible and was holding Shergar in Libya.
sentences.zh: 甚至一度有人猜测，利比亚政治领袖穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲上校（Colonel Muammar al-Gaddafi）是幕后黑手，并将谢加藏在了利比亚。

sentences.en: The theory was that Colonel Gaddafi had struck a deal with the IRA to steal
sentences.zh: 这一理论称，卡扎菲上校与爱尔兰共和军达成协议，偷走

sentences.en: Shergar in exchange for weapons because he was opposed to the Aga Khan's position as a Muslim spiritual leader, a position he felt he was much better suited to.
sentences.zh: 谢加来换取武器，因为他反对阿迦汗作为穆斯林精神领袖的地位，他觉得自己比对方更适合这个位置。

sentences.en: It was argued that Colonel Gaddafi had decided to kidnap Europe's most famous force as a way to demonstrate the influence and power he held, while causing the
sentences.zh: 有人认为，卡扎菲上校决定绑架欧洲最著名的赛马，以此来展示他所拥有的影响力和权力，同时给

sentences.en: Aga Khan great embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗造成巨大的难堪。

sentences.en: This theory was rejected by authorities and Shergar shareholders, as there was no
sentences.zh: 这一理论被当局和谢加的股东们驳回了，因为根本没有

sentences.en: evidence to suggest that Colonel Gaddafi even knew who Shergar was, let alone had anything to do with his kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 任何证据表明卡扎菲上校甚至知道谢加是谁，更不用说与他的绑架有任何瓜葛了。

sentences.en: There were also theories that Shergar may have been taken by someone who was jealous of his success.
sentences.zh: 还有一种理论认为，谢加可能是被某个嫉妒他成功的人带走的。

sentences.en: The Aga Khan had an ongoing rivalry with a Kentucky-based bloodstock agent named Wayne Murdy over
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗与一位驻肯塔基州的纯血马经纪人韦恩·穆迪（Wayne Murdy）之间长期存在竞争关系，

sentences.en: a complicated horse sale in 1978 that had ultimately worked out in the Aga Khan's favour.
sentences.zh: 起因是1978年一桩复杂的马匹交易最终对阿迦汗更为有利。

sentences.en: Wayne had been furious which led the media to report he may have retaliated against the Aga Khan by stealing Shergar.
sentences.zh: 韦恩对此愤怒不已，这导致媒体报道称他可能通过偷走谢加来报复阿迦汗。

sentences.en: Wayne denied any involvement and without any evidence to link him to the crime, the theory dissipated over time.
sentences.zh: 韦恩否认了任何牵连，并且在没有任何证据将他与此案联系起来的情况下，这一理论随着时间的推移而烟消云散。

sentences.en: In an interview, Wayne admitted that he hated the Aga Khan enough that he would have relished pulling off
sentences.zh: 韦恩在一次采访中承认，他恨阿迦汗恨到甚至会很乐意去策划

sentences.en: Shergar's kidnapping, but emphasised he would never stoop that low.
sentences.zh: 谢加的绑架案，但他强调自己绝不会卑鄙到那种地步。

sentences.en: Years went by without any breakthroughs in the case.
sentences.zh: 多年过去了，案件一直没有任何突破。

sentences.en: In July of 1997, the IRA called a final ceasefire and on April 10 1998, a treaty known as the Good Friday Agreement was signed, marking an end to the troubles.
sentences.zh: 1997年7月，爱尔兰共和军宣布最终停火；1998年4月10日，被称为《耶稣受难日协定》（Good Friday Agreement）的条约签署，标志着北爱尔兰冲突的结束。

sentences.en: Over the course of the IRA's 30-year campaign, approximately 1800 people were killed, including 640 civilians and 1100 members of the British
sentences.zh: 在爱尔兰共和军长达30年的武装斗争期间，大约有1800人丧生，其中包括640名平民和1100名英国

sentences.en: security forces, and an estimated 10,000 IRA members were imprisoned at various times.
sentences.zh: 安全部队成员，据估计有1万名爱尔兰共和军成员在不同时期被关押入狱。

sentences.en: The same year that the Good Friday Agreement was signed, an autobiography was published that claimed to reveal the truth about what happened to Shergar.
sentences.zh: 就在《耶稣受难日协定》签署的同一年，一本自传出版了，声称要揭露关于谢加遭遇的真相。

sentences.en: Titled The Informant, the book was written by Sean O'Callaghan, a former senior member of the IRA who had also worked as a police informant for the Garda.
sentences.zh: 这本书名为《告密者》（The Informant），由肖恩·奥卡拉汉（Sean O'Callaghan）撰写，他曾是爱尔兰共和军的高级成员，也曾担任过警方的警卫情报人员。

sentences.en: In his book, O'Callaghan claimed the IRA had been facing bankruptcy in the early 1980s and desperately needed money to further their campaigns.
sentences.zh: 奥卡拉汉在书中声称，爱尔兰共和军在20世纪80年代初面临破产，迫切需要资金来推进他们的行动。

sentences.en: So renowned leading member of the IRA, Kevin Mallon, was tasked with the job of raising several million pounds.
sentences.zh: 因此，爱尔兰共和军著名的领导成员凯文·马龙（Kevin Mallon）被委以重任，负责筹集数百万英镑。

sentences.en: O'Callaghan claimed that Mallon gathered a small team from Dublin to pull off the theft, including one IRA member named Jerry Fitzgerald.
sentences.zh: 奥卡拉汉声称，马龙从都柏林召集了一个小团队来实施这起盗窃，其中包括一名名叫杰里·菲茨杰拉德（Jerry Fitzgerald）的爱尔兰共和军成员。

sentences.en: Two weeks after Shergar was taken, Fitzgerald confided in O'Callaghan that he was responsible and said only a handful of other people knew about the plot.
sentences.zh: 在谢加被盗两周后，菲茨杰拉德向奥卡拉汉吐露实情，承认自己是幕后黑手，并称只有少数其他人知道这个阴谋。

sentences.en: According to Fitzgerald, just hours after the theft, Shergar became extremely distressed and started thrashing about.
sentences.zh: 据菲茨杰拉德透露，就在盗窃发生几小时后，谢加变得极其烦躁不安，开始剧烈挣扎。

sentences.en: His captors were unable to calm him down and he eventually injured one of his legs.
sentences.zh: 他的绑架者无法让他安静下来，最终导致他的一条腿受伤。

sentences.en: Not knowing what to do, the IRA members decided they had no choice but to shoot Shergar and then pretend he was still alive in order to collect the ransom money.
sentences.zh: 由于不知所措，爱尔兰共和军成员认为别无选择，只能枪杀谢加，然后假装他还活着，以便勒索赎金。

sentences.en: When they realised that the syndicate wasn't going to pay without proof that Shergar was still alive, the group abandoned the plan and ceased all communications.
sentences.zh: 当他们意识到辛迪加在没有看到谢加还活着的证据之前绝不会付钱时，这伙人便放弃了计划并切断了所有联系。

sentences.en: O'Callaghan confirmed an ongoing theory that the thieves had made the mistake of thinking
sentences.zh: 奥卡拉汉证实了一个流传已久的理论，即小偷们犯了一个错误，以为

sentences.en: that the Aga Khan was Shergar's sole owner and would therefore be the only one deciding whether or not to pay the ransom.
sentences.zh: 阿迦汗是谢加的唯一所有者，因此将是唯一一个决定是否支付赎金的人。

sentences.en: They also didn't think that theft would attract anywhere near the amount of media attention that it did.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有想到这起盗窃案会引发如此巨大的媒体关注度。

sentences.en: Summarising the kidnapping, O'Callaghan said, quote,
sentences.zh: 奥卡拉汉在总结这起绑架案时说道，原话是：

sentences.en: It was a total cock-up from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 从头到尾简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: Police documents from the time corroborate this story as there were reports that a small group of men from the IRA suddenly changed their behaviour around
sentences.zh: 当时的警方文件证实了这一说法，因为有报告称，一小群爱尔兰共和军男子在

sentences.en: the time that Shergar was taken.
sentences.zh: 谢加被盗前后突然改变了行为举止。

sentences.en: But no definitive evidence exists and O'Callaghan's claims have never been proven.
sentences.zh: 但并没有确凿的证据存在，奥卡拉汉的说法也从未得到证实。

sentences.en: In 1999, a movie titled Shergar was released based loosely on the events surrounding the
sentences.zh: 1999年，一部名为《谢加》（Shergar）的电影上映，该片大致根据围绕

sentences.en: theft and it went on to win the award for Best Foreign Film at the Temecula International Film Festival in California.
sentences.zh: 这起盗窃案的事件改编，并随后在加利福尼亚州的特梅库拉国际电影节上荣获最佳外语片奖。

sentences.en: That same year, a special race named the Shergar Cup was held at the Goodwood Racecourse in West Sussex, England to commemorate Shergar's memory.
sentences.zh: 同年，在英格兰西萨塞克斯郡的古德wood赛马场举行了一场名为“谢加杯”（Shergar Cup）的特殊赛马比赛，以纪念谢加。

sentences.en: The race was designed to be a light-hearted competition with a unique racing format similar to the Ryder Cup in golf and the winners were presented
sentences.zh: 这场比赛旨在成为一项轻松愉快的比赛，采用类似于高尔夫莱德杯的独特赛制，获胜者将被授予

sentences.en: with a silver statue of Shergar, donated by the Aga Khan.
sentences.zh: 由阿迦汗捐赠的谢加银质雕像。

sentences.en: The Shergar Cup was so popular that it became an annual event, which today is called the Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup and is held at Ascot Racecourse in England.
sentences.zh: 谢加杯大受欢迎，以至于成为了一项年度赛事，如今被称为迪拜免税店谢加杯（Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup），在英格兰的阿斯科特赛马场举行。

sentences.en: In the spring of 2000, a council worker named Tommy Foley was clearing out a narrow valley in
sentences.zh: 2000年春天，一名名叫汤米·弗利（Tommy Foley）的市议会工人正在清理

sentences.en: County Kerry Island when he found a rotting coal sack hidden underneath a rock.
sentences.zh: 凯里岛（County Kerry Island）的一个狭窄山谷，当时他在一块巨石下发现了一个腐烂的煤袋。

sentences.en: It was badly disintegrated, indicating it had been there for a significant amount of time.
sentences.zh: 它已经严重分解，表明它已经在那里呆了很长时间。

sentences.en: Tommy unwrapped the sack and inside, he discovered a horse's skull containing two bullet holes.
sentences.zh: 汤米打开了袋子，在里面发现了一个带有两个弹孔的马头骨。

sentences.en: Thinking it was Shergar, Tommy was beside himself and news quickly spread throughout town that Shergar had been found.
sentences.zh: 汤米以为这就是谢加，兴奋得无以复加，谢加被找到的消息很快传遍了整个小镇。

sentences.en: Des Leden, an equine veterinarian and clinical pathologist, was called to examine the skull.
sentences.zh: 拥有兽医和临床病理学家双重身份的德斯·莱登（Des Leden）被请来检查这个头骨。

sentences.en: A detailed examination revealed the skull belonged to a two-year-old horse, whereas Shergar was five years old at the time he was stolen,
sentences.zh: 详细检查显示，该头骨属于一匹两岁的马，而谢加被盗时已经五岁了，

sentences.en: ruling out the possibility that it was him.
sentences.zh: 从而排除了这就是他的可能性。

sentences.en: On January 27 2008, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper published an article titled The Truth About Shergar Racehorse Kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 2008年1月27日，《星期日电讯报》（Sunday Telegraph）发表了一篇题为《赛马谢加绑架案的真相》的文章。

sentences.en: The article expanded on IRA member turned police informant Sean O'Callaghan's story that Kevin Mallon had orchestrated the kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章详细阐述了由爱尔兰共和军成员转变为警方情报人员的肖恩·奥卡拉汉的故事，即凯文·马龙策划了这起绑架案。

sentences.en: According to a source close to a former IRA member, the plan to kidnap Shergar had been sanctioned by the IRA's ruling body, the Army Council.
sentences.zh: 据一位接近前爱尔兰共和军成员的消息人士透露，绑架谢加的计划得到了爱尔兰共和军最高领导机构——陆军委员会的批准。

sentences.en: The kidnapping plot had failed from the start because the vet who'd agreed to look after Shergar pulled out on the night of the theft.
sentences.zh: 绑架阴谋从一开始就失败了，因为原本同意照顾谢加的兽医在盗窃当晚临阵退缩了。

sentences.en: Four days into the ransom negotiations, the Army Council decided it was too much trouble for little gain and told the IRA to release Shergar.
sentences.zh: 在赎金谈判进入第四天时，陆军委员会认为麻烦太大却收益甚微，于是下令爱尔兰共和军释放谢加。

sentences.en: By this point, the guarder were looking for Shergar all over Ireland and Kevin Mallon was under surveillance, making it impossible to transport the horse without getting caught.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，警卫正在全爱尔兰搜寻谢加，凯文·马龙也受到了监视，这使得在不被抓获的情况下运送这匹马变得不可能。

sentences.en: Mallon instead allegedly ordered that Shergar be shot and two handlers opened fire on him using a machine gun.
sentences.zh: 据称，马龙转而下令枪杀谢加，两名看护人员随即用机枪向他开火。

sentences.en: According to the source, it was a, quote, very bloody death and it took several minutes for Shergar to succumb to his injuries.
sentences.zh: 据该消息人士透露，那是一场，原话是，“非常血腥的死亡”，谢加花了整整好几分钟才伤重身亡。

sentences.en: The article concluded, quote,
sentences.zh: 文章最后总结道，原话是：

sentences.en: And so, the greatest racehorse of the century was butchered in the same way that the IRA killed many of its human enemies.
sentences.zh: 就这样，本世纪最伟大的赛马被残酷屠杀，其方式就像爱尔兰共和军残害其许多人类敌人一样。

sentences.en: The source did not know exactly where Shergar's body was buried, but the fact that his carcass was riddled with
sentences.zh: 该消息人士并不知道谢加的尸体具体被埋在哪里，但他的尸体被打成了

sentences.en: bullets meant the gang did everything to ensure Shergar's remains were never found.
sentences.zh: 筛子这一事实意味着这伙歹徒竭尽全力确保谢加的遗体永远不会被找到。

sentences.en: Many in the Republic, including broad Republican sympathisers, would never have forgiven the IRA
sentences.zh: 共和国的许多人，包括广泛的共和党同情者，永远不会原谅爱尔兰共和军

sentences.en: and its political wing, Sinn Féin, for machine gunning the equine pride of the nation in cold blood.
sentences.zh: 及其政治翼新芬党（Sinn Féin）冷血地用机枪扫射这匹国家的马中骄子。

sentences.en: In 2017, the Royal Mail released a series of postage stamps featuring racehorse legends, including Shergar.
sentences.zh: 2017年，英国皇家邮政发行了一系列以赛马传奇为主题的邮票，其中包括谢加。

sentences.en: The back of the pack read, In the summer of 1981, Shergar was the meteor that filled the racing sky.
sentences.zh: 邮票包装背面写着：在1981年的夏天，谢加是划破赛马天空的流星。

sentences.en: On August 29 2019, Shergar's vet, Stan Cosgrove, passed away.
sentences.zh: 2019年8月29日，谢加的兽医斯坦·科斯格罗夫（Stan Cosgrove）逝世。

sentences.en: He never received an insurance payout for
sentences.zh: 他从未获得过关于

sentences.en: Shergar's theft and had been forced to sell his 120-acre farm to recoup costs involved with his shares in the
sentences.zh: 谢加失窃的保险赔偿，为了弥补他所持有的这匹马的股份所带来的损失，以及他在失败的悬赏金骗局中损失的8万英镑，他被迫卖掉了自己120英亩的农场。

sentences.en: horse, as well as the 80,000 pounds he lost in the failed reward money scam.
sentences.zh: 他还因在尝试寻回谢加方面所做的工作而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: Stan was remembered as an extraordinary equine veterinarian and for the work he did in trying to recover Shergar.
sentences.zh: 斯坦被人们铭记为一位杰出的马医，

sentences.en: Many believe Shergar's remains are most likely hidden in County Leitrim, a largely deserted area that covers a land mass of 1,590 square kilometres.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为谢加的遗体很可能藏在利特里姆郡，这是一个面积达1590平方公里、人迹罕至的地区。

sentences.en: At the time, the area was used for IRA training camps and to house members of the IRA who were on the run.
sentences.zh: 当时，该地区被用作爱尔兰共和军的训练营，以及为逃亡中的爱尔兰共和军成员提供藏身之所。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, police secretly excavated some boggy areas in County Leitrim looking for Shergar, but with no success.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，警方秘密挖掘了利特里姆郡的一些沼泽地以寻找谢加，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Des Leiden, the equine veterinarian and clinical pathologist, says he still receives skeletal remains from time to time that require testing to see if they belong to Shergar.
sentences.zh: 身为马医和临床病理学家的德斯·莱登表示，他至今仍不时收到需要测试的动物骨骼残骸，以确定它们是否属于谢加。

sentences.en: A DNA profile for Shergar has been completed and is stored securely in case it is ever required to make a positive identification in the future.
sentences.zh: 谢加的DNA图谱已经完成并安全保存，以防万一未来需要进行确切的身份确认。

sentences.en: It was able to be completed because two veterinarian students had come forward following
sentences.zh: 之所以能够完成，是因为有两名兽医学生在

sentences.en: Shergar's theft to admit they'd plucked two hairs from Shergar's tail to keep as souvenirs while studying at Balimani's stud.
sentences.zh: 谢加失窃后主动站出来承认，他们在巴利马尼（Balimani）的种马场学习时，曾从谢加的尾巴上拔下两根毛发作为纪念品留存。

sentences.en: To this day, the IRA has never claimed responsibility for stealing Shergar, although the Garda, the Aga Khan and a majority of Shergar's shareholders believe they were to blame.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，爱尔兰共和军从未承认对偷走谢加负有责任，尽管警卫、阿迦汗以及谢加的大多数股东都认为他们难辞其咎。

sentences.en: In recent times, it's been suggested that former IRA members still haven't acknowledged their involvement
sentences.zh: 近年来，有人指出前爱尔兰共和军成员仍然没有承认他们参与其中

sentences.en: because the troubles and the organisation's terror tactics are a painful old wound that the people of
sentences.zh: 因为北爱尔兰问题以及该组织的恐怖手段是爱尔兰人民

sentences.en: Ireland want to move on from.
sentences.zh: 希望走出来的痛苦旧伤。

sentences.en: The investigation into what happened to Shergar is no longer active, and former members of the IRA have no reason to come forward if they were responsible,
sentences.zh: 对谢加失踪事件的调查已经不再进行，前爱解队成员如果对此负有责任，也没有理由站出来，

sentences.en: as they'd only risked putting their fellow ex-comrades behind bars.
sentences.zh: 因为这只会让他们冒着把昔日战友送进监狱的风险。

sentences.en: Prior to Stan Cosgrove's death, he commented that the IRA's silence only served as proof that they were responsible.
sentences.zh: 在斯坦·科斯格罗夫去世前，他曾评论说，爱解队的沉默恰恰证明了他们难辞其咎。

sentences.en: He believed that they chose to remain silent out of shame, regret and the fear of bad publicity after realising that they, quote, had done a repulsive thing to the Irish people.
sentences.zh: 他认为，他们在意识到自己对爱尔兰人民做出了“令人作呕的事”之后，出于羞耻、悔恨和对负面宣传的恐惧才选择保持沉默。
